subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should Discord gain a default-off silent audio preflight history mode for `requireMention` channels, and what consent, retention, cost, inheritance, and visibility limits should it enforce?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the change intentionally processes and retains speech from messages that did not invoke the bot, making the boundary a maintainer product/security choice.

options.title: Define scoped Discord policy
options.body: Add a default-off Discord guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, cost bounds, schema/docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Wait for shared media-history policy
options.body: Keep this as product input but avoid a Discord-only knob until maintainers define cross-channel media retention semantics.

options.title: Decline silent transcription
options.body: Keep current mention-gated behavior if maintainers decide unmentioned speech should not be transcribed or retained without direct invocation.

recommendation.title: Define scoped Discord policy
recommendation.body: Add a default-off Discord guild/channel policy with explicit consent, retention, cost bounds, schema/docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This person already merged the adjacent Discord audio preflight fix and made the related product distinction for the `requireMention:false` case.
